name: Hierarchical Error Metric Calculation
definition: A fast method to calculate error values at every tree node based on the mean square error (MSE) between a parent node's low-resolution data and its eight immediate child nodes, taking the maximum error of the children into account. This avoids the high I/O and computational cost of comparing against raw data.
summary: Hierarchical Error Metric Calculation computes node errors by combining child block MSE with maximum child error, ensuring monotonicity and avoiding raw data access for efficient adaptive octree construction.
